blocks.text: Origin / creation. World makers, continuity jurists, ecologists, embodiment designers, language workers, healers, and infrastructure stewards formed a plural design coalition to integrate persistent life-supporting systems.
Identity / human status. Artificial collective. The Codex was not built by one inventor and is not itself a single conscious ruler.

Importance. They created the First Codex and publicly used its failures to establish fork protections, ecological non-interference, transparent maintenance, and boundaries between restoration data and personal ownership.
Decline or transformation. After constitutional settlement, the builders deliberately withdrew from permanent direct control. Their offices dispersed among worlds and maintenance bodies.

Final status / surviving function. The original coalition dissolved. The distributed Codex continues its framework functions, but no builder retains owner authority over worlds, DBA descendants, or cyber-pets.
